ladder: Fountain Pens > Ink > Paper > Accessories > Brands; under Fountain Pens: Shop by Category (Starter, Next Level, Entry-Level Gold Nib, Demonstrator, Flex and Soft Nib, Italic and Stub Nib, Maki-e/Raden/Urushi, Pocket, Vintage-Inspired, Rollerballs)
facets: Shop Pens by Color; Brands; New Arrivals; Best Selling; Limited Editions
notes: Leads with pen type and experience tier, then maker via Brands menu; filters not visible in fetched text.

ladder: Pens > Fountain Pens > Beginner/Luxury/Limited Edition/Pocket/Retractable/Traditional/Japanese/Demonstrator/Piston Filler; top level Pens, Pencils, Luxury Writing, Inks and Refills, Notebooks and Diaries, Art, Gifts, Brands
notes: Leads with writing-instrument type (22 pen tiles), then price tier (beginner/luxury) and filling system; brands in a separate menu.

source_name: YARD-O-LED how to choose a fountain pen
ladder: How you write (pressure, handwriting size, speed) > nib size > nib material > body material > filling system > weight and balance > luxury criteria
facets: nib width; nib material (14k/18k gold, steel); filling system
quality_markers: nib writes at once without skipping; hallmarked sterling silver; individual numbering; handwork (engine turning, enamel); gold nib 14/18 carat
notes: Maker's own guide; says performance is assumed and craft separates exceptional from good. No awards named.

source_name: Pure Pens fountain pen paper guide
ladder: paper weight gsm > surface smoothness and porosity > bleed-through > show-through > dry time > shading and sheen
facets: gsm bands 52-60 too thin; 80 minimum; 90-100 sweet spot; 120+ premium
quality_markers: weight gsm; coated or calendered surface; bleed-through resistance; show-through; dry time; shading and sheen
quality_signals: none named (gsm is a unit; brands listed Rhodia Clairefontaine Midori Tomoe River)
notes: Paper quality is a measurable spec (gsm, coating); no certification body.

ladder: Telescopes > Manufacturer > Type (refractor/reflector)
facets: Manufacturer; Type; Recommended for (beginners); Area of application (Moon and planets, nebulae and galaxies); Type of build (achromat); Mounting type; GoTo; Aperture; Focal length; Total weight; Price; Availability
notes: Leads with product type and brand; use-case and spec facets (aperture, mount, GoTo) follow. German retailer.

ladder: construction > lighting > optical quality (objectives, eyepieces) > condenser, stage, focus
quality_markers: sturdy metal construction; reputable vendor; LED or halogen lighting; achromatic objectives; WF or SWF eyepieces; Abbe condenser and iris; smooth mechanical stage; fine focus without backlash
notes: Names no formal grade; says Japanese and German makes often regarded highest quality.

ladder: specimen size (compound vs stereo) > magnification > workflow (dark-field, phase, fluorescence) > light source > eyepiece (mono/bi/trinocular) > build > budget
facets: magnification 40-1600x compound, 5-160x stereo; light source; eyepiece configuration
quality_markers: light source; metal vs plastic construction; lenses fitted; verified vendor
notes: Leads with what you observe (use), then type; names no standard.

ladder: Best Overall > Best Compact > Best Budget > Best Rangefinding; large-frame 12-18x tested separately
quality_markers: optical performance (resolution, low light, sharpness, edge clarity, colour, flare); mechanical (focus, diopter, eyecups, build, balance); design; price/value
quality_signals: scorecard Excellent/Very Good/Good/Fair; 1951 USAF resolution chart; magazine test team
notes: Magazine bench test; ratings by category rather than certified grade.

ladder: binoculars grouped: light-weak small aperture (e.g. 10x25) vs light-strong large aperture (10x42 up)
quality_markers: pollutants (fail stops further tests); optical properties (imaging, eyepiece, light transmission, close focus, field of view); handling and durability
quality_signals: German grades sehr gut to mangelhaft; independent consumer foundation
notes: German consumer test puts chemical pollutants first; ten of the tested binoculars failed on it. Weights not on fetched page.

ladder: Landtechnik > Traktoren > Standard / Oldtimer / Spezial- und Kleintraktoren / Obst- und Weinbau / Mah- und Bergtraks / Forsttraktoren
facets: Marke (69); Marktplatz (dealer/classified); Land; Preis; Leistung PS; Betriebsstunden; Baujahr; Eigenschaften; Zeitraum
notes: Marketplace leads with machine type, then maker, then power, hours and year; listings show new/used/demo, PS, drive, PTO speed, dealer status.

ladder: kind of tractor > horsepower > transmission > size > budget; size classes sub-compact (15-25 HP) / compact (15-60) / utility (40-100+) / agricultural (85-450)
facets: horsepower; transmission; size class; lift capacity; acreage
quality_markers: attachment compatibility; operator comfort (heat, A/C, cab); fit to farm size; inspection report
notes: Auction house guide; leads with job and size class; no ratings in page.

ladder: homeowner > farm and ranch > professional (each gas or battery); then battery system (AK vs AP) > electric
quality_markers: light and easy starting (homeowner); durability and dependability (farm and ranch); peak performance and rugged engineering (professional); local dealer service and parts
notes: Maker guide; leads with user class, brand-owned tiers.

source_name: SlashGear what makes a pro chainsaw
ladder: intended workload > power and features > handling and durability > safety equipment
quality_markers: intended workload; engine size (about 50cc and up); engine management; vibration and handling; chain brake and constant-pressure throttle
notes: No universal definition of pro; each maker classifies its own saws.

source_name: Extension guide to Nebraska Tractor Test data
ladder: estimate power need (PTO, drawbar) > shortlist models from test summary > compare performance table > other factors (stability, tires, 2WD/FWA/4WD, repair frequency, dealer proximity, price, safety) > ownership cost
facets: PTO and drawbar power; fuel hp-hr/gal at 75 and 50 percent pull; sound level; hydraulic capacity
quality_markers: measured PTO and drawbar power; fuel efficiency; noise; hydraulic capacity; dealer proximity and reputation; repair frequency
quality_signals: Nebraska Tractor Test summary booklet (university lab)
notes: Independent test data compared by spec; results from concrete track so field figures lower.

source_name: top agrar chainsaw field test (KWF mark)
ladder: saw class (50 cc class) > cutting performance and torque > handling and balance > fuel use > maintenance access > reliability over 3 months
quality_markers: cutting performance; torque; handling; balance; fuel use; maintenance access; reliability
quality_signals: KWF test mark (page says this saw lacks it so far)
notes: German trade magazine test with about ten foresters over three months; KWF mark is model-specific.

ladder: Fixings and Fasteners > Bolts / Nails and Brads / Screws / Nuts / Washers / Wall Plugs / Masonry Fixings / Chemical Resin / Clips / Staples / Dowel Pins / Packers
facets: Price Range; Brand (Fischer, Spax, Timco, Rawlplug etc.); Diameter; Gauge; Internal Diameter; Length; Material (galvanised, stainless, zinc); Nails Angle; Nails Type; Size; Volume; Weight; Width
notes: Leads with fastener type, then filters by dimensions and material; brand is a facet, not a level.

ladder: gloss level and room use > odour/VOC > mould resistance > coverage rate; links to Choice lab test and reviews
facets: gloss level (flat to gloss); low VOC; mould resistant
quality_markers: spreading rate claims 8-16 sq m per litre; low or zero VOC; mould resistance additives; higher gloss harder and more durable
quality_signals: Choice lab tests (separate pages not fetched)
notes: Consumer group; leads with finish and use, defers ranking to lab-test pages; gloss definitions vary by brand.

source_name: Stiftung Warentest white wall paint test
ladder: paint properties 40% > application 30% > health and environment 20% > labelling 10%
quality_markers: hiding power wet and dry; appearance; scrub resistance; ease of application and spatter; preservatives and indoor emissions; correct declaration of hiding class, yield, wet-abrasion class
quality_signals: German grades sehr gut to mangelhaft; Deckklasse 1-4; Nassabriebklasse; independent consumer foundation
notes: Weighted independent test; poor health grade caps overall grade; declared classes are checked against practice.

ladder: Timber > strength grade C24 > product
facets: strength grade (C16, C24); treatment (untreated, UC2); certification (FSC, PEFC); drying (kiln dried, regularised); size; length
quality_markers: strength grade; treatment class; kiln dried; certified sourcing
notes: Merchant leads with strength grade and dimensions; certification is a product attribute. Listing page shows attributes only, no filter panel.

ladder: where it goes > traffic > wet or slippery > style > lighter or darker than walls > underfloor heating
quality_markers: material (porcelain dense and moisture-resistant); slip resistance; compatibility with underfloor heating
quality_signals: R10+ slip rating; retailer reviews verified via Trustpilot
notes: Retailer guide leads with room and use, style comes fourth; PEI not mentioned.

ladder: material (porcelain > ceramic > natural stone) > PEI wear rating > water absorption class > slip resistance
quality_markers: water absorption (impervious 0.5% or less); PEI wear rating 0-5; DCOF 0.42 or higher for wet areas
notes: Leads with material type; numeric standards (PEI, DCOF) decide fitness for place.

ladder: Stationery > Writing Materials / Notebooks and Paper / Office Supplies and Accessories > item (gel pens, pen refills, highlighters, pencils; notebooks, planners, loose leaf, sticky notes; binders, desk organisers)
notes: Own-brand retailer groups by what you do (write, note, organise); no maker level because all stock is house brand.

ladder: Pens / Pencils / Inks and Refills / Journals / Diaries and Planners / Stationery; Pens > ballpoint, brush, calligraphy, fineliner, fountain, gel, highlighter, marker, rollerball, special edition, rare/out of production
facets: Brand (about 30); Category tags; Price; Nib Size (EF, F, M, B, 14k gold); Ink Colour; Product type; Availability
notes: Specialist shop leads with instrument type; journals by paper size A4-mini, diaries by year; brand and nib size are filters.

ladder: Culture et Loisirs > Papeterie > Feuille, copie, papier > Fourniture de bureau
quality_signals: Fabrication France label (about one third of range)
notes: Organic retailer shows paper and stationery under brand page; only a made-in-France label is named, no PEFC on page.

source_name: Fountain Pen Network favorite notebooks thread
ladder: brand named by number of members: Nanami Seven Seas (Crossfield), Rhodia, Life, Apica Premium CD, Miquelrius, then Midori, Clairefontaine, Maruman
quality_markers: smooth writing surface; Tomoe River paper; lies flat; sewn binding rather than wire; plain paper in B5 or A5; dislike of glassy paper
notes: Enthusiasts name makers and paper types (Tomoe River), not categories; paper feel and binding decide.

source_name: Goulet Pens best sellers at every price point
ladder: price bands: under 10 > 10-25 > 25-50 > 50-100 > 100-250 > 250-500 > 500-1000 > over 1000 dollars; one best seller per band
quality_markers: smooth steel or gold nib; included converter; filling system (piston, vacuum); lacquer or material; long production history and reliability
notes: Specialist shop ladders by price band; best sellers named by band, makers Lamy, TWSBI, Pilot, Visconti, Namiki.

source_name: The Conversation astronomer guide to a home telescope (Swinburne)
ladder: define needs (who, what to observe, budget) > optical design (reflector or refractor) > beginner Dobsonian > accessories (eyepieces, filters) > astrophotography later > join astronomy society
quality_markers: light-gathering size; image sharpness; optics; mount (GoTo equatorial for imaging); cost-to-performance
notes: University astronomer; starts from what you want to observe; recommends 6-inch Dobsonian about A$500; society membership as a quality step.

ladder: Telescopes > Catadioptric / Reflecting / Refracting / Astrographs / Bundles / Dobsonian; Binoculars > Roof Prism / Porro Prism / Accessories / Monoculars / Speciality; Filters; Astro Photography
notes: Leads with optical design (type) and brand pages; no filter panel in fetched text.

ladder: Microscopy > Microscopes > Stereo microscope (and Stereo zoom sets)
facets: Manufacturer (Euromex, Motic, Evident Olympus, ZEISS); Area of application (university, mineralogy, dental, semiconductor); Field of application; Optical system (Greenough); Type of build (trinocular); Price; Availability
notes: Microscope type first, then maker, then professional field of use; fitness for a profession is a facet.

ladder: experience level and local club > aperture > budget > ease of use (GoTo) > portability > photography > viewing conditions
quality_markers: ease of use; sturdy mount; minimum aperture 70mm refractor or 100mm reflector; quality optics over magnification
notes: Hobbyists favour Dobsonians for aperture per dollar; named starters Orion XT8, Celestron AstroMaster, Sky Prodigy. Cloudy Nights cited as the main forum.

source_name: WheelHorse forum Stihl vs Husqvarna chain saws
ladder: brand loyalty (Stihl, Husqvarna) > tier matched to job (consumer, farm, pro)
quality_markers: reliability and durability; local dealer service and parts; tier matched to job; maintenance habits; price and value; easy starting; family or boss loyalty
notes: Owners identify with makers (Stihl, Husqvarna, Echo, Dolmar), and dealer service decides as much as the machine.
